name: Tourist / Business Visa (Immigration Proclamation No. 354/2002, Art. 12)

requirements.blocker_text: Travel must fall under the Tourist, Transit, or Business visa category defined by Immigration Proclamation No. 354/2002, Art. 12.

outcome.duration_length: 30 or 90 days, single entry (USD 60) or multiple entry (USD 150) -- pricing shown is from a US-mission consular page and may vary by issuing post/nationality

sources.title: Ethiopian Embassy (consular mission page) -- visa services: Tourist visa 30 or 90 days, single entry USD 60 / multiple entry USD 150; registration with ICS required if stay exceeds 90 days (Art. 13, Proclamation 354/2002)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Ethiopia). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 sourced via an official Ethiopian diplomatic mission consular page. GAP: the central evisa.gov.et portal could not be reached in this build (TLS certificate error) -- fee/duration figures here come from one embassy's consular page and may not reflect the current central e-visa fee schedule or vary by issuing post. A separate Business visa exists requiring ICS registration if the stay exceeds 90 days -- modeled here as part of the same route rather than split out, given thin distinguishing detail.
